accepted_findings: The frozen Jan-Jul 2024 snapshot ledger is deterministic and passes its declared technical QA.
Prefix invariance/no-repaint, independent identity parity, row hashes, geometry, session scope and forbidden-column checks pass for that ledger.
E1/E2/E3 remains display/localization order, not a quality rank.
No future outcome was used to build or audit the snapshot ledger.

hard_blockers.close_condition: Generate, hash and independently QA outcome-free candidate/snapshot ledgers covering all declared historical windows, with required warm-up, before any real label is generated or read.
hard_blockers.finding: The only frozen real ledger ends on 2024-07-31, while DEV starts at 2024-08-01 and historical replication starts at 2025-08-01.
hard_blockers.impact: There are zero frozen feature rows for the declared DEV and replication windows.

hard_blockers.close_condition: Freeze and QA a primary identity protocol before outcomes. Preferred: instrument stable causal source/provenance IDs while proving geometry parity. At minimum, obtain separate Pro approval for a family/geometry-preserving display-episode identity and its pre-registered sensitivity analysis.
hard_blockers.finding: Episode identity is deterministic but post-hoc and materially ambiguous; it may continue across family changes and large geometry changes.
hard_blockers.impact: Two of four proposed model features—episode_age_c5 and origin_family—depend directly on that identity, and first-contact selection also depends on it.

hard_blockers.close_condition: Implement and freeze the labeler without running it on real DEV/replication outcomes; test all event-order and timestamp edge cases.
hard_blockers.finding: The primary reaction definition exists only as prose; no canonical deterministic labeler and synthetic edge-case suite is present.
hard_blockers.impact: Arming, evolving zone geometry, episode disappearance, bar availability, missing minutes, contact-bar ordering, session truncation and exclusions remain implementation degrees of freedom.

hard_blockers.close_condition: Freeze a conservative rule before outcomes, such as a dedicated AMBIGUOUS_CONTACT_BAR_ORDER class or starting favorable-event eligibility only after the contact bar.
hard_blockers.finding: The preregistration permits the contact bar to satisfy the favorable high, but M1 data cannot establish whether the favorable high occurred before or after the zone contact.
hard_blockers.impact: A pre-contact high can be incorrectly counted as a favorable reaction.

hard_blockers.close_condition: Implement and test the single frozen pipeline, lock software versions, and hash all code before real outcomes are opened.
hard_blockers.finding: No canonical model/training/score/replication/prospective evaluation implementation is present.
hard_blockers.impact: Transformations, tie handling, convergence behavior, exclusions and gate calculations can still vary after outcomes are visible.

hard_blockers.close_condition: Freeze exact formulas. Recommended primary continuous statistic: AUC minus 0.5; 5,000 session-date cluster bootstrap resamples; percentile CI; fixed invalid-resample rule; fixed DEV quantile method and boundary convention; prospective sub-blocks split by complete ordered NY sessions.
hard_blockers.finding: The term 'continuous score association' and several gate mechanics are not mathematically complete.
hard_blockers.impact: The primary statistic, confidence interval, quartile ties, invalid bootstrap samples and three sub-block construction could be selected after seeing results.

hard_blockers.close_condition: Rename the estimand to a conditional pre-contact/display-episode reaction rank, hash the full generator dependency graph plus raw/Z4 inputs and environment, then create a canonical two-stage seal recording method commit, artifact commit, run ID and artifact digest.
hard_blockers.finding: The source universe is conditional on an upper Z4, locality within 2v and top-3 sticky display; the current freeze points to trigger commit 111045c while generated artifacts live in 278528c, and upstream generator/data/environment dependencies are not fully sealed for later periods.
hard_blockers.impact: An 'intrinsic E strength' interpretation would overgeneralize, and later-period reproducibility is not yet cryptographically closed.

outcome_blind_identity_diagnostics.note: Diagnostics use only the frozen outcome-free ledger and the frozen identity rule. They do not assess reaction or profitability.

required_repairs_before_regate: Freeze the conditional estimand and non-overclaiming name.
Repair and QA episode identity outcome-blind.
Build outcome-free ledgers for DEV_HISTORY and HISTORICAL_REPLICATION_DIAGNOSTIC before labels.
Implement and freeze the reaction labeler with timestamp and contact-bar rules.
Implement and freeze the model/evaluation pipeline and exact statistics.
Lock dependencies and seal all upstream data/code hashes.
Run a new Pro pre-outcome gate.
